description.narrative: 1. Promote civic engagement and consultative dialogues within state and non-state actors for effective and sustainable socio-economic development in Bangladesh 2. Ensuring sustainable economic growth by facilitating green industrial transition, promoting climate-resilient practices, and strengthening ethical and responsible business conduct in Bangladesh.

SDG Facility Project of Bangladesh intends to emphasis two areas; firstly the civic engagement in policy formulation, modification and operationalisation for decent work, climate change, gender equality, food and agricultural loss and secondly to conduct an assessment to the textile industries to review their existing practices of energy efficiency. Both of these would contribute to the overall socio-economical development ensuring human rights based approach.
